Summary: CISA's ScubaGear assessment of Microsoft 365, run by Maester or read from its results, with every policy result in the Maester report.

Prerequisites.Text: To let Maester run ScubaGear: Windows, and ScubaGear 2.0 or later installed in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (not PowerShell 7). Run these once in Windows PowerShell.
To read results you already have, on any platform: the folder or ScubaResults file Invoke-SCuBA wrote.
PowerShell 7.4 or later for Maester itself.

Steps.Text: Optionally connect Maester to the tenant. The pack then checks that ScubaGear's results are for the same tenant, and a connection app-only with a certificate is passed on to ScubaGear.

Notes: ScubaGear runs in its own Windows PowerShell process and signs in there itself: in a sign-in window, or app-only with the app and certificate Maester is connected with.
ScubaGear 2.0 does not run in PowerShell 7: its sign-in window needs Windows PowerShell. Set ScubaGear.PowerShell to pwsh once a version of ScubaGear supports PowerShell 7.
ScubaGear can take half an hour or more on a large tenant. Raise Execution.LongRunningTimeoutSeconds in maester-config.json if Maester stops it first.

Options.Name: ScubaGear.ReportPath
Options.Text: Read these ScubaGear results (the ScubaResults file, the run's folder or the -OutPath folder) instead of running ScubaGear.

Options.Name: ScubaGear.MaxReportAgeDays
Options.Text: Refuse results older than this. 0 turns the check off.

Options.Name: ScubaGear.ProductNames
Options.Text: The products to check, for example ["aad", "exo", "securitysuite", "sharepoint", "teams", "powerplatform", "powerbi"].

Options.Name: ScubaGear.ConfigFilePath
Options.Text: A ScubaGear configuration file, with its exclusions, omissions and annotations.

Options.Name: ScubaGear.OutputPath
Options.Text: Where ScubaGear writes its reports. Kept when set.

Options.Name: ScubaGear.PowerShell
Options.Text: The PowerShell that runs ScubaGear: powershell, pwsh or the full path of one.

Options.Name: ScubaGear.ModulePath
Options.Text: Run the ScubaGear module at this path instead of the newest one installed.

AppOnly.Text: Connect Maester to Graph app-only with a certificate in the Windows certificate store. ScubaGear uses the same app and certificate, and the tenant's initial domain. Give the app the permissions and roles ScubaGear's documentation lists for a service principal.
